title: Morning Brief
summary: Legal work was time-sensitive, with the law-firm agreement, payment and materials due before the Monday response, and the landing page still carried Cosmos references to remove. Performance improved over two to three days while the product-page versus presales test was inconclusive, so the split moves from 20% to 50/50. Cash pressure, weak agency communication and unclear accounting follow-up remained concerns.
points: Logan is onboarding as a creative strategist; AVIA and Haskap still need dedicated strategists, plus a copywriter, designer, creative lead and senior editor
AVIA's masterclass form and links block the email programme
Haskap's welcome, cancellation and abandoned-cart flows need its product page first
Internal tools will be centralised; student-facing tools wait
The school needs a structured retention model; Private Circle materials are progressing
Unauthorised use of company assets was found, and access needs a review
decisions: Move the product page versus presales split to 50/50
Remove Cosmos references before any external use
End the contracts of the editors who misused assets

tasksImported.title: Sign the law-firm agreement, make the payment and send the response
